name: The Forbidden Forest
source:
When you went to sleep last night, you never expected to wake up in a different world… Yet here you are. Trapped in a magic forest, you join forces with one of its victims to attempt an escape. All kinds of dangers await… will you be able to work together and find the legendary scroll that will save the Kingdom of Ortania, or will you forever wander... [i]The Forbidden Forest?[/i]

[From [url=https://inessy.itch.io/the-forbidden-forest-wip]Itch.io[/url]]
